description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 10.0 with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 18.0 to 28.0 with tick labels at intervals of 2.0. A purple line, marked with circular data points, represents “Consistency-CE” and begins at (0.0, 21.0), increases to (2.5, 24.0), continues to (5.0, 25.0), and ends at (10.0, 26.0). A blue line, marked with square data points, represents “Inconsistency-CE-MP” and begins at (0.0, 18.0), increases to (2.5, 23.0), continues to (5.0, 26.0), and ends at (10.0, 27.0). A red line, marked with star-shaped data points, represents “Consistency-Bi” and begins at (0.0, 22.0), increases to (2.5, 26.0), continues to (5.0, 27.0), and ends at (10.0, 28.0).
